preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**5 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == n for n, permutation in zip(test_cases, output_permutations))
postconditions.description: Each output permutation has the same length as the corresponding input n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation) for n, permutation in zip(test_cases, output_permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(permutation)) == n for permutation in output_permutations)
all(permutation[i] != i + 1 for i, permutation in enumerate(output_permutations))
postconditions.description: No element in the permutation is equal to its 1-based index.

postconditions.expression: all(output_permutations[i] <= output_permutations[i + 1] for i in range(len(output_permutations) - 1))
postconditions.description: Permutations are output in lexicographically increasing order.
